007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.VectorIndex;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.VectorIndexAttributes;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.VectorIndexConfig;
015import org.slf4j.Logger;
016import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
017
018/**
019 * Sample for reading configured Select AI vector-index status.
020 *
021 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, initialize
022 * a {@link VectorIndex} object from {@link VectorIndexConfig}, call
023 * {@link VectorIndex#getStatus()}, and print the configured status.</p>
024 *
025 * <p>This sample does not call {@link VectorIndex#create()}. It reads the
026 * status value configured on the local vector-index object.</p>
027 *
028 * <p>To run this sample, provide an object-storage location through
029 * {@code SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_LOCATION}. The location must be readable by the
030 * credential configured for the vector index and should reference documents
031 * suitable for embedding. When using Oracle Object Storage, ensure the
032 * credential, bucket or object URI, network access, and compartment/provider
033 * settings are configured before running the sample.</p>
034 *
035 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
036 * <ul>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
038 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
039 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
040 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME</li>
041 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
042 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_LOCATION</li>
043 *   <li>SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME</li>
044 * </ul>
045 *
046 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
047 * <ul>
048 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_STATUS - {@code Enabled} or {@code Disabled}.
049 *       Defaults to {@code Disabled}.</li>
050 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DESCRIPTION - vector index description.</li>
051 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_WAIT_FOR_COMPLETION - defaults to {@code false}.</li>
052 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_DB_PROVIDER - defaults to {@code oracle}.</li>
053 * </ul>
054 *
055 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
056 * <pre>{@code
057 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
058 * }</pre>
059 *
060 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
061 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
062 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
063 * <pre>{@code
064 * mvn clean install
065 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
066 * }</pre>
067 *
068 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
069 * <pre>{@code
070 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
071 *   -d samples/out \
072 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/vectorindex/GetVectorIndexStatusSample.java
073 * }</pre>
074 *
075 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
076 * <pre>{@code
077 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
078 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex.GetVectorIndexStatusSample
079 * }</pre>
080 *
081 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
082 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
083 * and diagnostics.</p>
084 */
085public final class GetVectorIndexStatusSample {
086    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(GetVectorIndexStatusSample.class);
087
088    private GetVectorIndexStatusSample() {
089    }
090
091    public static void main(String[] args) {
092        String indexName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME");
093
094        try {
095            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
096            VectorIndex vectorIndex = selectAI.vectorIndex(buildVectorIndexConfig(indexName));
097
098            System.out.printf("Configured vector index status: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(vectorIndex.getStatus()));
099        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
100            LOGGER.error("Failed to initialize Select AI vector index '{}'.", indexName, e);
101        }
102    }
103
104    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
105        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
106                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
107                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
108                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
109                .build();
110
111        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
112    }
113
114    private static VectorIndexConfig buildVectorIndexConfig(String indexName) {
115        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
116        VectorIndexAttributes attributes = VectorIndexAttributes.builder()
117                .location(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_LOCATION"))
118                .objectStorageCredentialName(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME"))
119                .profileName(profileName)
120                .vectorDbProvider(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_DB_PROVIDER", "oracle"))
121                .build();
122
123        return VectorIndexConfig.builder(indexName)
124                .description(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DESCRIPTION",
125                        "Vector index initialized by the Java Select AI SDK sample."))
126                .status(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_STATUS", "Disabled"))
127                .waitForCompletion(Boolean.parseBoolean(
128                        envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_WAIT_FOR_COMPLETION", "false")))
129                .vectorIndexAttributes(attributes)
130                .build();
131    }
132
133    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
134        String value = System.getenv(name);
135        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
136            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
137        }
138        return value;
139    }
140
141    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
142        String value = System.getenv(name);
143        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
144    }
145
146    private static String valueOrEmpty(Object value) {
147        return value == null ? "" : String.valueOf(value);
148    }
149}
